senses.zh_definition: 若指 FLDSMDFR：动画电影《天降美食》系列中，Flint Lockwood 发明的虚构食物制造机器的名称。
senses.en_definition: If intended as FLDSMDFR, the name of Flint Lockwood's fictional food-making machine in the Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs films.
senses.ms_definition: Jika merujuk kepada FLDSMDFR, nama khas mesin rekaan Flint Lockwood yang menghasilkan makanan dalam siri filem Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs.
senses.nuances: 这里只提供有条件的专名识别，不提供未经证实的马来语普通词义。下列组合和例句是按电影语境编写的示例，未经语料验证为高频搭配。[名称及电影语境说明](https://scifi.stackexchange.com/questions/13823/what-powers-the-fldsmdfr-when-its-in-the-sky)

dual_scenarios.context: 影视评论 / 专名说明
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam ulasan filem ini, ejaan "fldsmdfr" merujuk kepada FLDSMDFR, sebuah mesin rekaan Flint Lockwood.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在这篇影评中，拼写“fldsmdfr”指的是 Flint Lockwood 发明的机器 FLDSMDFR。
dual_scenarios.en: In this film review, the spelling "fldsmdfr" refers to FLDSMDFR, a machine invented by Flint Lockwood.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Mesin fldsmdfr tu yang buat makanan dalam filem tu, kan?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Mesin FLDSMDFR itulah yang menghasilkan makanan dalam filem itu, bukan?
dual_scenarios.zh: fldsmdfr 就是电影里那台制造食物的机器，对吧？
dual_scenarios.en: The FLDSMDFR is the machine that makes food in that film, right?
spoken_features: tu 是 itu 的口语形式。
小写 fldsmdfr 模拟聊天拼写；专名通常写作 FLDSMDFR。

etymology.historical_story: The likely reference is a fictional invention, rather than an inherited Malay word. FLDSMDFR abbreviates Flint Lockwood Diatonic Super Mutating Dynamic Food Replicator, the food-making machine associated with Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs. This explains the unusual consonant sequence, but the packet alone cannot establish that its lowercase token names that machine. [Reference](https://scifi.stackexchange.com/questions/13823/what-powers-the-fldsmdfr-when-its-in-the-sky)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 若确认是电影专名，就把 FL 接到 Flint Lockwood，把末尾 FR 接到 Food Replicator；不要把整串字母硬拆成马来语音节。
